[Review Number 477] I play some R.I.P. Reincarnation Insurance Program and give my opinion throughout... skip to the end if you just want the review summary. How does the game compare to similar roguelite ARPGs like Cybercorp, Greedland or Hell Clock? Is it worth buying or playing for $15?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985950/RIP__Reincarnation_Insurance_Program/

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:06 Opening
x Gameplay
x Verdict

Steam description: "Welcome to the Reincarnation Insurance Program! This top-down roguelite shooter blends Diablo-style looting with Survivor-like mayhem. Face screen-filling zombie tides, use Divine Tech to liquidate them into ash, and farm god-tier gear to forge your OP build."
